description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, specifically for converting strings to camelCase and Title Case within the application's UI. It helps ensure consistent string rendering across different components.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a given string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and multiple whitespace, returning the normalized camelCase string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a given string to Title Case for display, normalizing delimiters, collapsing whitespace, and capitalizing appropriate characters, including after apostrophes.
